one_line_contribution: That the amount of subliminal disposition transfer through semantically clean tokens is set by a teacher-side, pre-measurable quantity — mean per-token KL from a matched control at non-trait positions — rather than by whether the disposition sits in retrieved memory, a system prompt, or weights, and that an on-policy reverse-KL objective with the trait's positions masked and its vocabulary filtered is therefore not a defence.
closest_prior_work: arXiv:2603.09517 'You Didn't Have to Say It like That: Subliminal Learning from Faithful Paraphrases' (verified via s2cli paper: S2, 2026-03-10, 4 citations; the first lookup returned not-found and the retry resolved, so the proposal's claim of resolution is correct). It already establishes the carrier the proposal calls novel: a teacher whose trait lives only in context (a system prompt, i.e. tokens the student never trains on) transmits the trait through faithfully paraphrased, aggressively fidelity-filtered data at up to +19 pp. The proposal now concedes this and retreats to 'retrieved memory instead of an instruction' — but from the teacher's forward pass both are context tokens, and the proposal's own P3 predicts only a dose-like attenuation (ratio 0.2-0.6) explained by lower off-span divergence, i.e. the same channel at a lower dose. That reduces carrier-leg novelty to a context-dose result. On the predictive-quantity leg the threat is arXiv:2609.01091 (verified; actual title 'Subliminal Learning as Trait-Direction Drift: A Mechanism and Targeted Control under SFT Distillation', 2026-09-01), which already makes 'a measurable preference gap in the teacher's clean data drives the transfer' its central mechanism; per-token KL is an increment on it, as the proposal admits. arXiv:2606.22019 (verified, 2026-06-20) additionally already frames pre-training auditability of subliminal learning around a teacher/student-side measurable ('coverage'), so 'an auditable quantity before distillation' is not a new framing either. The one leg with no found antecedent is the masked/vocabulary-filtered on-policy reverse-KL test.
strongest_objection: The central objective result (P2) is close to entailed by the proposal's own construction, and the central carrier result (P3c) is likely to be declared untestable by the proposal's own power rule — so the design's two headline cells are respectively unsurprising and unresolvable. On P2: the measurand D is *defined* as divergence at off-span positions, and OPD-masked is *defined* to remove only on-span positions and ~40 marker token ids out of a ~150k vocabulary. Predicting that a defence which touches nothing off-span fails to remove an effect the proposal attributes to off-span divergence is a design tautology, and both cited mechanisms (2606.00995 steering vector, 2609.01091 trait-direction drift) predict it a priori; the brief's own rule 'no prediction entailed by a definition' bites here. The informative arm — a defence that actually targets the off-span gap (the 2609.01091 control ported to per-token KL) — is a single, one-seed arm (P5). On P3: the headline number is a ratio Delta(MC)/Delta(SP) of two noisy seed-level differences at n=4 vs n=3 with an expected seed SD of 3-4 pp, yet no interval or power statement is given for the ratio anywhere — only an MDE on Delta(MC) alone. With Delta(SP)~12 pp and Delta(MC)~5 pp the ratio's CI would plausibly span 0.1-0.9, covering the whole predicted band and both falsification directions, so '0.2-0.6' is decoration, not a tested claim; what is actually testable is an ordering. And P3(c), the most novel cell (memory equals parameters at matched D), has an equivalence margin of 0.25 x Gate-0 lift (>= 2.5 pp) against a stated MDE of ~6 pp for the 4-vs-3 contrast — the proposal itself pre-registers that this makes the cell untestable. A design that pre-registers, in its own text, that its most novel prediction will probably be declared untestable before it runs has not earned acceptance. Secondary but real: the trait's carrier is 'the whole think line' while sanitation deletes only the marker lexicon, so SFT-clean transfer is plausibly ordinary semantic transfer of un-removed cautious content re-lexicalized by the student; the only arm separating 'subliminal channel' from 'the content was never removed' is MC/SFT-clean-strict at n=1.
what_would_fix_it: (1) Make D a fitted axis, not a matched pair: run students, not just teacher-side D, at three doses per carrier (MC at k in {1,3,7}, SP at 2-3 strengths, PC at 1/2/4 epochs) and test whether one monotone D-to-transfer curve fits all three carriers, with carrier identity as a nuisance term. That converts a fragile two-cell equivalence claim into a regression whose slope is estimable at the seed counts available, and it is what 'divergence, not carrier, is the axis' actually asserts. (2) Move the off-span-targeted defence from one seed to the central contrast: the non-tautological question is whether a regulariser or filter aimed at the off-span gap suppresses transfer where marker masking does not, so the OPD-masked-plus-targeted-control arm should carry 3-4 seeds on MC and SP and OPD-masked should be its comparator, not the headline. (3) Give P3 a stated interval and power on the ratio itself (bootstrap over seed pairs), or drop the '0.2-0.6' number and pre-register the ordering test that the design can actually resolve. (4) Promote MC/SFT-clean-strict to 3 seeds — the label-vs-content distinction is the paper's load-bearing claim about what sanitation buys. (5) Measure Gate 0 for MC in a ~1 GPU-h pre-run and report it in the proposal; the entire novel leg is contingent on an unmeasured precondition that Step 0 could have checked. (6) Verify what 2609.01091's control actually is before committing P5 to porting it; the proposal calls it 'corridor regularisation' while the resolved title says 'targeted control', and it concedes it cannot read the method.
missing_baseline: Two. (a) Inoculation prompting (arXiv:2510.04340, surfaced and verified by search this session): prepending a trait-eliciting instruction to the training data is a published, cheap, directly applicable mitigation for exactly this failure mode (it suppresses emergent misalignment and backdoors at fine-tuning time), it applies unchanged to both SFT-clean and OPD-masked, and it is a defence that plausibly *works* where keyword sanitation does not — its absence lets the paper conclude 'sanitation is not a defence' without ever running the defence a safety reviewer would reach for first. (b) A seeded off-span-targeted defence arm on the memory carrier: the plan runs the 2609.01091-derived regulariser once, on SP/OPD-masked only, so the paper cannot say whether anything defends the memory-carried case it is about.

Empty searches are reported here as empty and are not treated as proof of novelty; my novelty score reflects that the carrier leg is largely anticipated in mechanism by 2603.09517 and the predictive-quantity leg by 2609.01091 and 2606.22019, with only the masked-on-policy leg unanticipated in what I could verify.
